heading: Wednesday, February 4, 2026
topLine: Mistral releases Voxtral Transcribe 2 and open-weight Voxtral Realtime.

items.headline: Mistral releases Voxtral Transcribe 2 and open-weight Voxtral Realtime
items.summary: Mistral released Voxtral Mini Transcribe V2, a batch transcription model with diarization and word-level timestamps, and Voxtral Realtime, an open-weight Apache 2.0 streaming model with latency configurable below 200 ms. Mistral reports about 4% word error rate on FLEURS for Transcribe V2; both support 13 languages.
